evals.prompt: Review this iPhone onboarding design for an investment app and tell me how to adapt it to iPad and Mac.
evals.expected_output: A review table citing HIG areas plus an adaptation spec for iPad and Mac covering navigation, layout, pointer, keyboard and window behavior.
expectations: Recommends sidebar or split view where space allows on iPad and Mac
Mentions keyboard shortcuts or menu bar for Mac
States OS availability and fallback for Liquid Glass if used
